hints.content:
The point $(4,4)$ lies in the shaded area of both of the inequalities.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane with a graphed system of inequalities. The x- and y-axes both scale by one. There is a dashed line representing an inequality that goes through the points zero, two and one, two. The shaded region for the inequality is above the line. There is a solid line representing the second inequality that goes through the points negative four, one and zero, four. The shaded region for this inequality is below the line. The point four, four is plotted inside of the shaded region of both inequalities.

hints.content: Yes, $(4,4)$ is a solution of the system of inequalities.
